failed_face_cooccurrence.unit: failed main-trim faces with decoder IDs; NOT STEP face IDs

raw_curve_decomposition.unit: raw curve rows; normal reciprocal is NOT an error
raw_curve_decomposition.note: Decomposition used only when no invalid/self/repeated/directed-duplicate rows and E = 2R + U. Cross-pair geometric nearness is separate and may overlap.

face_xyz_mae.positive_means: optimized minus selected > 1e-12; deterioration of this metric only

matched_edge_mean_length.positive_means: optimized minus selected > 1e-12; deterioration of this metric only

saved_step.note: Distinct topological free edges are geometrically close; excludes seam/degenerate/same-face. Neither all free edges nor close pairs prove they should be welded.

limitations: 固定 369 个原生无效 solid 的全集；未知诊断不移出分母。原 test 的 7/2424 个契约不支持对象另列。
互斥图描述末端阻断分支，不是互斥根因。机制为多标签观察，总和可以超过 369。
wire 被舍弃不能证明它是内环、外环或孔；闭合 wire 和小 3D 残差也不能证明 UV 裁剪正确。
正常 reciprocal 是表示冗余；跨 pair 近曲线、GT 不近的面网格接近、STEP 近重合自由边是不同观察，不能混作模型重复。
阈值距离是归一化 XYZ 长度；旧 reciprocal CD 是双向均值平方距离之和，不能与新长度阈值直接比较。
端点最近邻残差只是一项必要条件代理，不是闭环或 B-Rep 有效性证明。
raw FP/FN 与失败裁剪面的关联是证据共现；面局部无向邻接正确不代表几何、方向或多重边正确。
成功组对照仅重读已有 CSV；未对成功组运行本次 OCC 溯源或新增几何诊断，描述性关联不是因果。

population_comparison.continuous_note: Existing reciprocal_cd_sq_mean = mean over reciprocal pairs of symmetric squared nearest-sample CD sum; unlike new length distances.

extra_pair.weighting: Pooled accepted count in bins shared by both groups; descriptive, not causal

definitions.trace_mechanisms: ever_observed across all main/fallback tolerances; not persistent blocking
definitions.persistent_trim_mechanisms: main final failed faces, plus open-wire discard in a returned face's actual successful attempt
definitions.threshold_nearness: both directed 64 arc-length sample-to-polyline sets have >=95% of distances <= threshold; new requires GT not near at same threshold
definitions.face_nearness: 16x16 nearest sampled grid vertices, not actual surface overlap
definitions.normal_reciprocal: opposite directed half-edges for one unordered face pair; by design, not duplicates
definitions.saved_step_nearness: 128 uniform native-parameter points; symmetric p95 point-to-polyline distance, not uniform arc length
definitions.endpoint_counts: endpoint occurrences per incident face, not unique vertices/edges; multiple nearby slots need not be multiple different edges
definitions.matched_edge_delta: only edges with the same GT pair; predicted FP curves are excluded from this matched delta
definitions.fitting_residuals: fixed samples: faces 16 subsampled input grid points, curves 16 input points, each fitted curve owner 9 uniform native-parameter points after periodic replacement. Positive if ANY measured residual maximum exceeds threshold; incomplete with no positive is unknown. Object distributions summarize observed maxima, not missing projections.
definitions.optimization_loss: First/last logged values precede optimizer updates; last log need not equal loss at returned geometry. Loss-down/GT-up event excludes returned-original branches as unknown.
definitions.evidence_gate: post-selection trajectory flags need status ok, no instrumentation errors, same recorded outcome, identical STEP DATA, and upstream source trace hash equal current trace hash

charts.name: terminal_stages
charts.title: 最终阻断分支
charts.note: 每件只计一个末端分支；完整重放需同时满足原字段一致、STEP DATA 一致和无观测异常。

charts.name: persistent_trim
charts.title: 最终裁剪状态
charts.note: 只看 main 最终失败面；成功面丢弃 wire 只看返回该面的成功尝试。对象标签可重叠，不把闭合候选失败直接解释为 UV 原因。

charts.name: upstream_discrete
charts.title: 更早出现的离散结构异常
charts.note: 面身份保持下的无向 pair 对照；结构异常与后续失败的共现不等于已证明因果。

charts.name: ever_observed
charts.title: 过程中出现过的记录（补充）
charts.note: ever-observed：main 和 fallback 的全部容差尝试。随后可能修复或改变，不能当作持续阻断率。

charts.name: threshold_sensitivity
charts.title: 阈值敏感性
charts.note: 线图仅显示已观察到的正例；未知数量可在下方标签表查看。near 要求双向各至少 95% 样本落在阈值内；new 要求 GT 在同阈值下不近。曲面项是网格顶点代理。

charts.name: optimization
charts.title: 优化前后对照
charts.note: 左图使用全部 2417 件的既有 fit-only 与 optimized 输出；右图只在失败全集看同阶段匹配量的距离变化。某项距离变差不等于整个几何或某个损失项造成失败。

charts.name: geometry_chain
charts.title: 优化目标、拟合与几何闭合之间的证据
charts.note: 左图：自拟合残差衡量曲面/曲线对各自输入的拟合；owner 残差衡量不同实体间的一致性。自拟合误差小不能排除边面不一致。面用 16 个网格子采样点、边用 16 个输入点、周期替换后曲线用 9 个原生参数样点到两侧有限拟合曲面；任一采样最大残差超阈值记正例，缺测而无正例记未知，不证明 UV 裁剪。本轮未对成功组计算这些新几何诊断，不能用失败组频率推断因果。右图：优化日志首末项下降且输出相应 GT 误差上升的共现；日志在每次更新前记录，末值不等于最终坐标损失，返回原坐标的分支记未知。匹配曲线误差排除无 GT pair 的预测边。

charts.name: curve_sources
charts.title: 边附近多条曲线的来源不能混合
charts.note: 左：正常双向半边与单向 rows；跨 pair 近曲线见阈值图。右：保存 STEP 中不同面上的自由拓扑边彼此接近，使用 128 个均匀原生参数样点的点到折线 p95，不是等弧长采样。它不代表一定应该焊合，也不把所有自由边叫作重复。

charts.name: structure_cooccurrence
charts.title: 上游结构与下游失败相接
charts.note: 左按对象，右按 main 最终失败面；对象可能同时含两类失败面。局部 pair 正确只指无向邻接，不证明方向、几何或多重边正确；这是共现而非因果。

charts.name: success_comparison
charts.title: 已有成功组对照
charts.note: 仅使用原 CSV，不重新诊断成功组；右图按 1–9 / 10–19 / 20–30 面分层，使用两组共有层的 pooled 面数权重。它控制粗粒度面数构成，不能排除其它混杂。
